using System;
using System.Collections.Generic;
using System.Linq;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel
{
    /// <summary>
    /// Provides a way to select services from the service provider.
    /// </summary>
    public interface IAIServiceSelector
    {
        /// <summary>
        /// Gets a service of the specified type from the service provider.
        /// </summary>
        /// <typeparam name="T">The type of the service to get.</typeparam>
        /// <returns>The service of the specified type.</returns>
        T GetService<T>() where T : class;
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Provides a default implementation of the <see cref="IAIServiceSelector"/> interface.
    /// </summary>
    public class AIServiceSelector : IAIServiceSelector
    {
        private readonly IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;

        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="AIServiceSelector"/> class.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="serviceProvider">The service provider to use to get services.</param>
        public AIServiceSelector(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
        {
            _serviceProvider = serviceProvider;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets a service of the specified type from the service provider.
        /// </summary>
        /// <typeparam name="T">The type of the service to get.</typeparam>
        /// <returns>The service of the specified type.</returns>
        public T GetService<T>() where T : class
        {
            return _serviceProvider.GetService<T>();
        }
    }

    /// <summary>
    /// Provides an ordered implementation of the <see cref="IAIServiceSelector"/> interface.
    /// </summary>
    public class OrderedAIServiceSelector : IAIServiceSelector
    {
        private readonly IServiceProvider _serviceProvider;

        /// <summary>
        /// Initializes a new instance of the <see cref="OrderedAIServiceSelector"/> class.
        /// </summary>
        /// <param name="serviceProvider">The service provider to use to get services.</param>
        public OrderedAIServiceSelector(IServiceProvider serviceProvider)
        {
            _serviceProvider = serviceProvider;
        }

        /// <summary>
        /// Gets a service of the specified type from the service provider.
        /// </summary>
        /// <typeparam name="T">The type of the service to get.</typeparam>
        /// <returns>The service of the specified type.</returns>
        public T GetService<T>() where T : class
        {
            return _serviceProvider.GetService<T>();
        }
    }
}

}
